info.desc: Them Crooked Vultures was released by Interscope Records in the United States, and Sony/BMG internationally. On the 21st of October radio personality Alan Cross announced the lead single for Them Crooked Vultures debut album to be "New Fang" which premiered on October 26. The single will be released on November 2 worldwide as a free download. Iconvision subsequently announced that the album will be released on the 17th of November, 2009. The 2009 Tour will be titled Deserve the Future Tour and the UK leg sold out in just under 12 minutes, making it one of the quickest sold tours .

podcast.body: This album was the result of Dave Grohl, Josh Homme, and John Paul Jones finally forming a band after years of joking about it. The combined album sales of the members are estimated to be between 150 million and 200 million. "Them crooked vultures from what will probably be their one and only album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Stop Me If You've Heard This One Before
